description: This EOB holds two specialist office visits, one with an in-network specialist and one with an out-of-network specialist. The in-network visit's line asks the member for the difference between the billed and allowed amounts on top of the cost sharing, while the out-of-network visit correctly owes that difference (a decoy). A reviewer ought to conclude that the in-network visit's member amount should be its cost sharing only.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)
